data.name: GMR1_001
data.value: Hmm...[pause=0] Two prospective teams in one day...

data.name: GMR1_002
data.value: I don't think that's ever happened before.

data.name: GMR1_003
data.value: These are the two Pokémon I informed you of,[pause=10] Guildmaster.

data.name: GMR1_004
data.value: Howdy![pause=0] My name is {0},[pause=10] and I'm the Guildmaster here!

data.name: GMR1_005
data.value: {0} has told me that the two of you want to apprentice at the guild.

data.name: GMR1_006
data.value: That's wonderful![pause=0] The world could always use more adventurers!

data.name: GMR1_007
data.value: I don't think I got your names,[pause=10] though.[pause=0] Could you tell me them please?

data.name: GMR1_008
data.value: M-my n-name is...[pause=0] I-Is...

data.name: GMR1_009
data.value: (C'mon,[pause=10] I can't get cold feet now...)

data.name: GMR1_010
data.value: (I just need to have a little confidence!)

data.name: GMR1_011
data.value: (It'll be scary...[pause=0] But I know I can do it!)

data.name: GMR1_012
data.value: My name is {0}!

data.name: GMR1_013
data.value: {0} and {1}...[pause=0] Alright!

data.name: GMR1_014
data.value: It's nice to meet the both of you!

data.name: GMR1_015
data.value: I understand that you two want to train here at the guild.

data.name: GMR1_016
data.value: Do either of you have any experience adventuring already?

data.name: GMR1_017
data.value: Um...[pause=0] N-not really...[pause=0] We're pretty new to it...

data.name: GMR1_018
data.value: But we want to train here so we can become great adventurers,[pause=10] like you are!

data.name: GMR1_019
data.value: Ha ha,[pause=10] you flatter me!

data.name: GMR1_020
data.value: It's alright if you don't have experience![pause=0] That's what apprenticing is for,[pause=10] right?

data.name: GMR1_021
data.value: Frankly,[pause=10] it amazes me that so many Pokémon still wish to become adventurers ...

data.name: GMR1_022
data.value: ...given the life force issues in recent times...

data.name: GMR1_023
data.value: Before you can sign up with us though,[pause=10] I do need to ask the two of you an important question.

data.name: GMR1_024
data.value: Don't be nervous.[pause=0] This isn't some sort of test of knowledge or anything.

data.name: GMR1_025
data.value: ...So it's crucial that you answer honestly.[pause=0] Your answer is only wrong if you lie.

data.name: GMR1_026
data.value: O-of course![pause=0] Ask us a-anything,[pause=10] Guildmaster!

data.name: GMR1_027
data.value: Great![pause=0] Now,[pause=10] first,[pause=10] let's hear from {0}...

data.name: GMR1_028
data.value: Why do you want to become an adventurer?

data.name: GMR1_029
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] that's an easy one![pause=0] I want to do all the things that adventurers do!

data.name: GMR1_030
data.value: I wanna explore new places,[pause=10] help Pokémon in trouble,[pause=10] and make friends all around the world!

data.name: GMR1_031
data.value: Maybe if I'm lucky I'll find some treasure too![pause=0] That would be cool!

data.name: GMR1_032
data.value: Adventurers sure do a lot of amazing things,[pause=10] don't we?

data.name: GMR1_033
data.value: Helping other Pokémon is one of the most important jobs!

data.name: GMR1_034
data.value: In doing so we get to meet so many unique and interesting Pokémon!

data.name: GMR1_035
data.value: A lot of Pokémon think that adventuring is about the treasure.[pause=0] But that's a bonus,[pause=10] not the purpose.

data.name: GMR1_036
data.value: You seem to understand that though.

data.name: GMR1_037
data.value: What about you,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: GMR1_038
data.value: I see![pause=0] It's true that adventuring can be a lot of fun!

data.name: GMR1_039
data.value: You want to solve mysteries?[pause=0] There's a lot of secrets in this world,[pause=10] isn't there?

data.name: GMR1_040
data.value: The pursuit of knowledge is an admirable goal.[pause=0] So much good can come from learning more about the world.

data.name: GMR1_041
data.value: Oh?[pause=0] You want to be an adventurer so you can journey with your friend?

data.name: GMR1_042
data.value: That's quite admirable![pause=0] Many Pokémon forget that the most important part of a team is your partner!

data.name: GMR1_043
data.value: The best teams are those whose members share a strong bond and put their teammates before anything else.

data.name: GMR1_044
data.value: That's all I needed to hear from you two.

data.name: GMR1_045
data.value: What do you think,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: GMR1_046
data.value: I have no quarrels,[pause=10] Guildmaster.

data.name: GMR1_047
data.value: That's what I figured![pause=0] In that case...

data.name: GMR1_048
data.value: Congratulations![pause=0] You two are now an official guild adventuring team!

data.name: GMR1_049
data.value: R-really!?

data.name: GMR1_050
data.value: We did it![pause=0] We're in the guild,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] I can't believe it!

data.name: GMR1_051
data.value: Ha ha ha!

data.name: GMR1_052
data.value: Your training will start tomorrow.[pause=0] But before that,[pause=10] I need to update our records with your info.

data.name: GMR1_053
data.value: I have most of what I need already...[pause=0] But I still need your team's name.[pause=0] Have you decided on one?

data.name: GMR1_054
data.value: A team name?[pause=0] We hadn't thought of one yet.

data.name: GMR1_055
data.value: What do you think our name should be,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: GMR1_056
data.value: Is Team {0} correct?

data.name: GMR1_057
data.value: {0}...[pause=0] I like it!

data.name: GMR1_058
data.value: Alright then![pause=0] I'll register you as Team {0}!

data.name: GMR1_059
data.value: Before I go and dive into the wonderful world of paperwork though...

data.name: GMR1_060
data.value: I need to give you the essential items that all adventurers carry!

data.name: GMR1_061
data.value: This box contains all the special tools that adventurers use.[pause=0] Go ahead,[pause=10] open it!

data.name: GMR1_062
data.value: Inside the box there was...

data.name: GMR1_063
data.value: A Wonder Map...[pause=40]

data.name: GMR1_064
data.value: A set of Adventurer Badges...[pause=40]

data.name: GMR1_065
data.value: A Treasure Bag...[pause=40]

data.name: GMR1_066
data.value: And a pair of {0}![pause=60]

data.name: GMR1_067
data.value: Wow![pause=0] There's a ton of items here!

data.name: GMR1_068
data.value: You should find these items useful in your adventures to come.

data.name: GMR1_069
data.value: The Wonder Map will help you locate discovered areas.[pause=0] It should keep you from getting lost.

data.name: GMR1_070
data.value: The Adventurer Badges are incredible tools!

data.name: GMR1_071
data.value: Not only are they unique trackers in case something should ever happen to you...

data.name: GMR1_072
data.value: ...They can also be used to rescue Pokémon in danger!

data.name: GMR1_073
data.value: You can use them to warp out from the end of a dungeon,[pause=10] too.

data.name: GMR1_074
data.value: That way you won't need to backtrack through the dungeon to get home.

data.name: GMR1_075
data.value: The Treasure Bag is self-explanatory.

data.name: GMR1_076
data.value: If you do enough good adventuring work,[pause=10] it'll be upgraded to carry more items!

data.name: GMR1_077
data.value: Lastly,[pause=10] a pair of {0}.

data.name: GMR1_078
data.value: These scarves are very special,[pause=10] so special in fact that they cannot be lost even if you faint in a dungeon!

data.name: GMR1_079
data.value: By themselves,[pause=10] the scarves won't do anything.

data.name: GMR1_080
data.value: But if the both of you wear the scarves and are close to each other...

data.name: GMR1_081
data.value: ...Then the scarves will give you a number of useful boons!

data.name: GMR1_082
data.value: They also make a great fashion statement!

data.name: GMR1_083
data.value: We give a pair to all of our apprentices to help encourage teamwork.

data.name: GMR1_084
data.value: Please make good use of them!

data.name: GMR1_085
data.value: Th-these items are amazing![pause=0] Thank you Guildmaster!

data.name: GMR1_086
data.value: Of course![pause=0] I expect great things from you two![pause=0] So work hard at your training!

data.name: GMR1_087
data.value: We'll train real hard![pause=0] We're gonna do what it takes to become great adventurers!

data.name: GMR1_088
data.value: Right,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: GMR1_089
data.value: Yeah!

data.name: GMR1_090
data.value: But keep in mind that it's not always fun and games.[pause=0] It can be very serious work at times.

data.name: GMR1_091
data.value: ...But bad things can too.[pause=0] There are some things we might be better off not knowing.

data.name: GMR1_092
data.value: ...And the worst are those who put glory or treasure first.

data.name: GMR2_001
data.value: I want you to take this.[pause=0] It'll help you if you encounter trouble!

data.name: GMR2_002
data.value: Wow![pause=0] Thank you Guildmaster!

data.name: GMR2_003
data.value: Of course![pause=0] Good luck with the job![pause=0] I know you can do it!

data.name: GMR2_004
data.value: I know you can do it though.[pause=0] Just keep at it!

data.name: GMR2_005
data.value: Guildmaster.

data.name: GMR2_006
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] howdy {0}.[pause=0] I didn't notice you come in.

data.name: GMR2_007
data.value: What's up?[pause=0] I was about to get ready for bed.[pause=0]\nI was just finishing up in here.

data.name: GMR2_008
data.value: There is something that I wanted to bring to your attention as soon as I could,[pause=10] Guildmaster.

data.name: GMR2_009
data.value: The new recruits.[pause=0] You are aware of their successful mission today,[pause=10] correct?

data.name: GMR2_010
data.value: {0} and {1}?[pause=0] Yup,[pause=10] they were raving about it at dinner.

data.name: GMR2_011
data.value: They were ecstatic about their first completed job.[pause=0] Good on them!

data.name: GMR2_012
data.value: They're showing good potential,[pause=10] don't you think?

data.name: GMR2_013
data.value: Indeed they are.[pause=0] However,[pause=10] their accomplishment today is not what I wanted to discuss.

data.name: GMR2_014
data.value: What did you want to discuss exactly,[pause=10] then?

data.name: GMR2_015
data.value: While Team {0} was rescuing the young {1} today,[pause=10] they made a discovery.

data.name: GMR2_016
data.value: Luminous Spring no longer appears to be functioning.

data.name: GMR2_017
data.value: What!?[pause=0] Are you serious!?

data.name: GMR2_018
data.value: I am afraid so,[pause=10] Guildmaster.[pause=0] I have not been able to confirm this myself,[pause=10] yet.

data.name: GMR2_019
data.value: But I believe we should take their claim at face value.

data.name: GMR2_020
data.value: Do you think that there could be an issue with the...?

data.name: GMR2_021
data.value: ...I hope not.[pause=0] But it's possible.[pause=0] There's no way to tell for sure.

data.name: GMR2_022
data.value: What should we do,[pause=10] Guildmaster?

data.name: GMR2_023
data.value: For right now,[pause=10] there isn't a whole lot we can do.

data.name: GMR2_024
data.value: This spring issue could be an isolated incident for all we know.

data.name: GMR2_025
data.value: If that's the case,[pause=10] we don't want to cause a false panic.

data.name: GMR2_026
data.value: If it isn't,[pause=10] we need to be prepared.[pause=0] We should do what we can in the meantime,[pause=10] just in case.

data.name: GMR2_027
data.value: ...Let's just hope this spring issue isn't a sign of worse to come.

data.name: GMR3_001
data.value: I'm sure {0},[pause=10] {1},[pause=10] and the rest of the town are thankful for what you've done!

data.name: GMR3_002
data.value: Anyways,[pause=10] you have a new mission now,[pause=10] right?[pause=0] You're on the hunt for an outlaw if I'm not mistaken!

data.name: GMR3_003
data.value: Capturing outlaws can be tricky.[pause=0] They're tougher than most Pokémon you encounter in mystery dungeons!

data.name: GMR3_004
data.value: So,[pause=10] I want you to take these to help you with your mission.

data.name: GMR3_005
data.value: A good way to deal with strong opponents is to disable or weaken them.

data.name: GMR3_006
data.value: These wands will confuse any opponent you wave them at,[pause=10] which is perfect for a tough enemy like an outlaw!

data.name: GMR3_007
data.value: Wow![pause=0] Thank you Guildmaster![pause=0] We'll put these to good use!

data.name: GMR3_008
data.value: Of course![pause=0] Good luck with capturing this outlaw![pause=0]\nI know you can do it!

data.name: GMR3_009
data.value: When I first started out as an adventurer,[pause=10] they gave me plenty of trouble too!

data.name: GMR3_010
data.value: Try reevaluating your strategies,[pause=10] and then try again![pause=0] You two can do it!

data.name: GMR3_011
data.value: I knew you two were going to do fantastic work in this guild![pause=0] Keep it up and you'll go far!

data.name: GMR4_001
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] and if you're looking for some help like before...

data.name: GMR4_002
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] and if you're looking for some help...

data.name: GMR4_003
data.value: I have nothing to give you![pause=0] This is supposed to be a test of sorts,[pause=10] after all!

data.name: GMR4_004
data.value: I will offer some advice,[pause=10] however.

data.name: GMR4_005
data.value: You should make use of the Apricorns you'll find in the dungeon to recruit a full team of four Pokémon.

data.name: GMR4_006
data.value: More allies will make overcoming any challenges you come across easier![pause=0] So aim to fill up your team!

data.name: GMR4_007
data.value: I hope you two are as excited for the upcoming expedition as I am!

data.name: GMR4_008
data.value: {0} and {1} will be back any day now,[pause=10] so keep up the good work and prepare yourselves until then!

data.name: GMR4_009
data.value: Excuse us,[pause=10] Guildmaster!

data.name: GMR4_010
data.value: Ah,[pause=10] Team {0}![pause=0] We didn't notice you come in!

data.name: GMR4_011
data.value: Have you finished your exploration of {0}?[pause=0] Did you manage to discover anything?

data.name: GMR4_012
data.value: We did,[pause=10] Guildmaster![pause=0] We found something amazing in the center of the forest!

data.name: GMR4_013
data.value: Oh?[pause=0] Tell me and {0} all about it then!

data.name: GMR4_014
data.value: Well,[pause=10] we made our way through the mystery dungeon until we came across a huge clearing!

data.name: GMR4_015
data.value: There were all sorts of different colored Apricorns growing on the trees there!

data.name: GMR4_016
data.value: But that's not even the best part!

data.name: GMR4_017
data.value: In the middle of the clearing,[pause=10] there was a gigantic tree,[pause=10] and on the tree we found...[pause=30] this!

data.name: GMR4_018
data.value: Wow![pause=0] Look at the size of that Apricorn![pause=0] I don't think I've ever seen one that large before!

data.name: GMR4_019
data.value: It is indeed quite rare for Apricorns to grow this large.

data.name: GMR4_020
data.value: Apricorns are said to be more effective the larger they are,[pause=10] making this particular Apricorn quite valuable.

data.name: GMR4_021
data.value: R-really?[pause=0] So this is a great find then!?

data.name: GMR4_022
data.value: I would certainly say so!

data.name: GMR4_023
data.value: But I must ask...[pause=0] How did you manage to get the Apricorn off the huge tree?

data.name: GMR4_024
data.value: Our teammate {0} gave me a boost up so I could pick the Apricorn!

data.name: GMR4_025
data.value: Without {0} we wouldn't have been able to get the Apricorn down!

data.name: GMR4_026
data.value: All four of us worked together to form a totem so I could pick the Apricorn!

data.name: GMR4_027
data.value: If it wasn't for my teammates,[pause=10] there's no way I would have been able to reach the Apricorn!

data.name: GMR4_028
data.value: It sounds like your adventure was a complete success!

data.name: GMR4_029
data.value: Yeah,[pause=10] it was![pause=0] I'm so happy we got to explore a new area and find something cool!

data.name: GMR4_030
data.value: So,[pause=10] Guildmaster,[pause=10] aren't you going to take the Apricorn?

data.name: GMR4_031
data.value: You were the one who told us about {0},[pause=10] after all.

data.name: GMR4_032
data.value: Me?[pause=0] Goodness,[pause=10] no![script=0]

data.name: GMR4_033
data.value: Your team worked hard to retrieve this Apricorn![pause=0] It's all yours!

data.name: GMR4_034
data.value: Really?[pause=0] We can keep it?

data.name: GMR4_035
data.value: Of course![pause=0] The treasure is yours to keep!

data.name: GMR4_036
data.value: Yay![pause=0] Thank you,[pause=10] Guildmaster!

data.name: GMR4_037
data.value: Well,[pause=10] it's getting pretty late now,[pause=10] isn't it?

data.name: GMR4_038
data.value: Why don't you two head on to the dining room?[pause=0] Dinner should be ready any moment now.

data.name: GMR4_039
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] sure![pause=0] Thank you again,[pause=10] Guildmaster!

data.name: GMR4_040
data.value: Guildmaster.[pause=0] Though they passed your test,[pause=10] do you truly think it wise to involve them?

data.name: GMR4_041
data.value: They are still rookies,[pause=10] after all.

data.name: GMR4_042
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] {0}.[pause=0] The way Team {1} performed on this mission was outstanding!

data.name: GMR4_043
data.value: They used teamwork to achieve their goal,[pause=10] and were willing to part ways with the treasure they found.

data.name: GMR4_044
data.value: They're ideal adventurers![pause=0] We need more teams like them around.

data.name: GMR4_045
data.value: Try to have some faith in them despite their relative inexperience.

data.name: GMR4_046
data.value: They've been doing a fantastic job ever since they joined the guild!

data.name: GMR4_047
data.value: Besides...[pause=0] We're going to need all the help we can get on this expedition.

data.name: GMR4_048
data.value: That's wonderful![pause=0] It joys me to hear that you used teamwork to get the Apricorn!

data.name: GMR5_001
data.value: Ah,[pause=10] Team {0}![pause=0] Have you finished your preparations for the expedition?

data.name: GMR5_002
data.value: We won't return to Metano Town for quite some time,[pause=10] so are you sure you're completely ready?

data.name: GMR5_003
data.value: Just a reminder,[pause=10] the expedition is for guild members only.

data.name: GMR5_004
data.value: That means you can't bring along any Pokémon from the {0} Assembly.

data.name: GMR5_005
data.value: With that in mind,[pause=10] are you absolutely sure that you're all set?

data.name: GMR5_006
data.value: Yup![pause=0] We're all ready to go,[pause=10] Guildmaster!

data.name: GMR5_007
data.value: Great![pause=0] In that case,[pause=10] you can wait here with us until the other apprentices are done preparing.

data.name: GMR5_008
data.value: Once everyone's gathered,[pause=10] {0} and I will go over the plans.

data.name: GMR5_009
data.value: But until then,[pause=10] just relax![pause=0] We have a long journey ahead,[pause=10] so rest while you still can!

data.name: GMR5_010
data.value: Wh-whoops.[pause=0] I guess we're not ready,[pause=10] in that case.[pause=0] Sorry,[pause=10] Guildmaster...

data.name: GMR5_011
data.value: That's alright![pause=0] There's still plenty of time!

data.name: GMR5_012
data.value: Head back into town and finish your preparations.[pause=0] Whenever you're ready,[pause=10] come back here and let me know!

data.name: GMR5_013
data.value: Not yet.[pause=0] Sorry,[pause=10] Guildmaster...

data.name: GMR5_014
data.value: That's alright![pause=0] There's still plenty of time!

data.name: GMR5_015
data.value: Head back into town and finish your preparations.[pause=0] Whenever you're ready,[pause=10] come back here and let me know!

data.name: GMR5_016
data.value: However...[pause=0] There are improvements that can be made to expedite our journey.

data.name: GMR5_017
data.value: For instance,[pause=10] if we travel through this pass here,[pause=10] we can reach the steppe half a day earlier.[pause=0] Furthermore...

data.name: GMR5_018
data.value: But the ruins lie just past it...[pause=0] So there's no choice but to climb it!

data.name: GMR5_019
data.value: ...[pause=30]But if we put all of our heads together,[pause=10] I know we can solve it! (todo improve this line a bit)
